name: Mike Thompson
stance: Calls for federal AI safety guardrails against catastrophic misuse and for a U.S.-led global AI safety framework.

statements.text: The House shouldn’t be taking a six-week recess while AI whistleblowers are issuing serious warnings about the potential danger and weaponization of these tools. We need to vote on bipartisan safety proposals now.
We must act before AI causes job losses, mass cybersecurity breaches, the development of biological or chemical weapons, or other devastating harm.
Joined 106 colleagues in calling on Speaker Johnson to pass AI safeguards.
Called on the administration to lead the international effort to establish a global framework for safety guardrails on AI.
